newsletter.heading: ReelBolt product news by email
newsletter.helper: We’ll email you a link to confirm your address first. You’re only added once you click it.
newsletter.checkInbox: Check your inbox to confirm. The link in the email we just sent finishes the sign-up.
newsletter.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, like you@company.com.
newsletter.consentRequired: Tick the box to confirm you want product news by email.
newsletter.error: We couldn’t send that just now. Check your connection and try again.
newsletter.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
newsletter.staleWording: Please reload the page and try again.
